text:
A simple illustration of a dynamic digital image of a scene between a woman and two different men dressed in modern clothes, standing among tropical plants.
In the center of the picture, a beautiful young woman with long red hair stands with her whole body turned towards the camera, dressed in a seamless tight high-necked silver dress with purple inserts, long sleeves, made of materials of the future. She looks about 35 years old, she has a slender build, fair skin and an elongated aristocratic face of dangerous beauty with a sly smile. 
On the right, the picture shows a young man with dark hair arranged in an elegant hairstyle, wearing a silver robe from the future, smiling from the corners of his lips. He stands a little behind the woman, pressing his chest against the woman's back and putting his hand on her shoulder, he looks directly into the camera. He looks about 35 years old, he has an elongated aristocratic face with a well-defined chin and deep-set black eyes. Dynamic pose in motion.
On the left, the picture shows a blond-haired young man with an elegant hairstyle, dressed in a silver robe from the future. He stands behind the woman, facing 3/4 to the center of the composition. He looks about 35 years old, he has an elongated aristocratic face with a well-defined chin, deep-set steel-colored eyes and a mouth slightly open in a sad smile. Dynamic pose in motion.
Background: A romantic atmosphere prevails, thanks to the soft lighting and details. Glossy bright green tropical plants with pink and purple flowers grow around, and metal walls with instruments and portholes of the underwater station of the future are visible in the background. The semi-darkness of the underwater world reigns behind the portholes of the station.
The atmosphere is romantic, light, cyberpunk, with extensive scenic concept art and rich textures. Futuristic style, high-quality detail, professional shooting, depth of field, detailed natural skin texture.
